About.title: A Tanzanian institution built on trust.
About.subtitle: Empowering individuals, women, entrepreneurs, and small businesses through responsible finance.
About.story: Joinus Finance Company Ltd is a licensed Tanzanian microfinance company. We pair accessible financing with financial education to close the financial inclusion gap — serving women's groups, entrepreneurs, and small businesses from Dar es Salaam and beyond.
About.vision: To be a trusted, leading microfinance institution promoting financial freedom across Tanzania.
About.mission: To provide affordable, responsible financial services combined with financial education and capacity building.

values.title: Integrity
values.desc: Honesty and the highest ethical standards.

values.title: Client Empowerment
values.desc: Every decision puts power in clients' hands.

values.title: Growth
values.desc: Continuous improvement, for clients and us.

About.regulation: Joinus Finance is a licensed Tier-2 microfinance provider operating under Bank of Tanzania regulation — committed to transparency, fair pricing, responsible collection, and data protection.
About.ctaBody: Join thousands of Tanzanians growing with Joinus Finance.

LoanProducts.title: Financing designed for you.
LoanProducts.subtitle: Seven loan products built around the real needs of Tanzanian individuals, families, and businesses.

group.name: Group Loans
group.desc: Women-focused group lending with financial literacy training and a weekly repayment structure that builds savings discipline.

business.name: Business Loans
business.desc: Financing up to TZS 200 million with flexible, tailored structures and fast processing for growing businesses.

salaried.name: Salaried Loans
salaried.desc: Affordable financing with monthly repayment aligned to your salary cycle.

property.name: Property Financing
property.desc: Finance home purchase, construction, renovation, or commercial property.

vehicle.name: Vehicle Financing
vehicle.desc: Financing for personal and commercial vehicles, trucks, and logistics fleets.

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle & Bajaji
motorcycle.desc: Helping bodaboda riders, bajaji drivers, and delivery businesses own their livelihood.

emergency.name: Emergency Loans
emergency.desc: Short-term financial support for qualified clients facing urgent needs.

LoanProducts.ctaBody: Talk to our team and we'll help you find the right solution.

ClientStories.title: Real people. Real growth.
ClientStories.subtitle: Behind every loan is a story of courage, ambition, and transformation.

items.name: Amina H.
items.before: Selling fabrics from a small market table, with no access to credit.
items.after: Expanded her shop, hired two employees, and tripled her income.

items.name: Peter M.
items.before: One worn-out truck and losing contracts he couldn't fulfil.
items.after: Bought a second truck; now serves 15 regular clients monthly.

items.name: Fatuma J.
items.before: A small food stall with seating for four and inconsistent income.
items.after: Runs a full restaurant serving over 80 customers a day.

items.name: Hassan M.
items.before: Renting a motorcycle daily, losing most of his earnings.
items.after: Owns his bodaboda; income up 60% and saving for a second.
